rev.t: We had a wonderful experience with this art class. My daughter felt comfortable from the very beginning, and Harshitha was kind, patient, and attentive to each child. The activities were creative and age-appropriate, helping build both …

I absolutely love what Harshita does in her classes.
My son genuinely enjoys going every single week. Initially, I was honestly worried — he’s quite a restless child, and I kept wondering how he would sit through …

I was recommended Etch Studio by a friend and took my daughter to check it out. She is currently enrolled in the summer camp and is loving it! Harshita does such great job in planning each activity and keeping the kids engaged. Highly recommend!
